description: This file defines a hierarchy of custom exception classes for handling service-related errors in a Dart/Flutter application. The exceptions include ServiceException as the base class, with specific subclasses for authentication, resource not found, network issues, validation errors, and server errors. These classes provide customized error messages and can carry additional error information.

classes.name: ServiceException
classes.description: Base class for service-related exceptions, implementing the Exception interface.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the exception, including message and optional original error.

classes.name: AuthenticationException
classes.description: Thrown when authentication fails, extends ServiceException.

classes.name: NotFoundException
classes.description: Thrown when a resource is not found, extends ServiceException.

classes.name: NetworkException
classes.description: Thrown on network issues, extends ServiceException.

classes.name: ValidationException
classes.description: Thrown when validation fails, extends ServiceException and includes an optional errors map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a message detailing validation errors, including specific field errors if available.

classes.name: ServerException
classes.description: Thrown on server errors, extends ServiceException, includes optional status code.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a 'Server Error' message with optional status code.
